description: Build a keyword bot flow (menu, buttons, replies) from a description in the merchant's words, any language. It is created SWITCHED OFF in the bot builder so the merchant can review and edit it, then switch it on. Uses 1 AI credit. Put everything the merchant described into "description": the trigger words, the menu options and each reply.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to build the flow (1 AI credit).

description.description: What the flow does, in the merchant's words (10–2000 characters).

name: draft_bot_flow
